name: Woops, All Marionettes
author: Manticor
bootlegger: If the poppy grower ability is in play the minions do not learn they are minions. They believe they are still their initial good character, but they are not. Once the poppy grower dies they learn their role and team.
If the poppygrower ability and boffin are both in play, the boffin does not find out what ability they are providing the demon until the poppygrower dies.
